versions.changelog:
amap-settle-guide v0.1.1

- Added new English tags to the skill for improved discoverability.
- Removed the redundant skill-card.md file; all documentation is now consolidated in SKILL.md.
- No major logic or feature changes; this is a metadata and documentation update.

**Initial release of 通勤找房助手 (Commute Rental Guide).**

- Find the best rental areas along metro lines based on workplace location, commute time, amenities, and rental cost/value.
- Designed for interns, fresh graduates, and job changers unfamiliar with new cities.
- Outputs Top 3 recommended areas with detailed listings, cost estimates, area highlights, and direct links to rental sites.
- Supports filtering by candidate areas, budget, and generating interactive or text-based map outputs.
- Provides CSV exports comparing areas and specific rental listings.
- Integrates with Amap API (requires AMAP_API_KEY) for location, commute, and amenities data.
